purpose: silver_nyc_flights cleans the bronze capture of the nycflights13 flights table (January-June 2013 departures from JFK, LGA, and EWR) into a typed flight-event table for analysts studying departure and arrival performance.
usage: Consumers should treat dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, and air_time as nullable fields whose nulls indicate a flight that never departed, per the source documentation, and must filter or handle these deliberately rather than assuming missing data; time_hour is a UTC TIMESTAMP suitable for time-series joins, while hour and minute remain the separately landed integer parts of the scheduled departure time.
limitations: The HHMM-encoded fields (dep_time, sched_dep_time, arr_time, sched_arr_time) remain INTEGER rather than a true time type because values up to 2400.0 are not valid HH:MM; consumers must parse them. Nulls in dep_time/dep_delay (null_rate 0.029388), arr_time/arr_delay/air_time (null_rate 0.0307-0.032981), and tailnum (null_rate 0.009154) are retained uncorrected. No row-level deduplication was needed given duplicate_row_rate 0.0 over 166158 rows, but the proposed grain (year, month, day, carrier, flight, sched_dep_time) has not been measured against the warehouse for uniqueness.
